snippet.title: Lady Knight Quest - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re delighted to reveal that we will be releasing Lady Knight Quest by ShiroKuroSoft on April 19! Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist to get ready for the release!

When the city-state of Marito falls on hard times, it submits to annexation by the expansive Vanderland Empire.

Lady Knight Quest on Kagura Games Store: https://www.kaguragames.com/product/lady-knight-quest/

Lady Knight Quest on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451330/Lady_Knight_Quest/
